summary: Phase 2 OMR PDF Generation testing completed successfully. All backend endpoints and frontend UI features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing OMR exams: 7b859047-f6cb-4760-b945-2e17b58c0099 (10 questions, 4 options) and 45f78690-e507-4071-a99a-8d8f3a9a6db8 (20 questions, 5 options)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 OMR PDF generation is complete. Both OMR exams now have PDFs generated. The OmrSheetCard component shows correctly with Download/Regenerate buttons when PDF exists.

POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/generate-omr-p.details: Generates PDF using ReportLab, uploads to Cloudinary, stores URL and bubble_map in exam document

GET /api/exams/{exam_id}/omr-pdf.details: Returns pdf_url and generated_at for exams with PDF, 404 for exams without PDF

GET /api/exams/{exam_id}/full.details: Returns correct total_points for OMR exams (num_questions * points_per_question)

exam_listing_omr_badge.details: OMR exams show green 'OMR' badge with grid icon

exam_listing_digital_badge.details: Digital exams show blue 'Digital' badge with monitor icon

configurar_clave_button.details: OMR exams show green 'CONFIGURAR CLAVE' button with key icon

gestionar_preguntas_button.details: Digital exams show purple 'GESTIONAR PREGUNTAS' button

descargar_hoja_button.details: OMR exams with PDF show 'DESCARGAR HOJA' button in listing

omr_sheet_card.details: OmrSheetCard component shows in ExamDetailView with correct state

omr_sheet_card_generated_state.details: Shows 'Hoja OMR generada' with date, 'Descargar PDF' and 'Regenerar' buttons

total_points_display.details: total_points correctly displayed in exam details (e.g., 20 pts = 10 questions x 2 pts)

answer_key_editor.details: AnswerKeyEditor shows bubble grid with correct number of questions and options
